# Australian Election Tracker

> Independent, individually sourced Australian election information published
> as open data. The first active tracker covers the Victorian state election on
> 28 November 2026.

Every material claim carries a dated source. The public Git repository preserves
all records, corrections and methodology changes. Data is licensed CC BY 4.0;
attribute reused data as "electiontracker.au".

## National entry points

- Home: https://electiontracker.au/
- Upcoming election calendar: https://electiontracker.au/elections
- Methodology: https://electiontracker.au/methodology
- About and independence: https://electiontracker.au/about
- Source repository: https://github.com/coldix/elections

## Victoria 2026 tracker

Canonical election root: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026

- Assembly: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/assembly
- Council: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/council
- District atlas: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/districts
- Region atlas: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/regions
- Parties: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/parties
- Policy comparison: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/parties/matrix
- Poll average: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/polls
- Voting guide: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/voting
- HTML data guide: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/data

Detail patterns:

- /elections/vic/2026/districts/<slug>
- /elections/vic/2026/regions/<slug>
- /elections/vic/2026/parties/<slug>
- /elections/vic/2026/policies/<slug>

Old short paths permanently redirect to these canonical election-scoped URLs.

## Coverage warning

Coverage counts only candidacies with an individually sourced record. A seat
with no recorded candidate means none has yet been verified, not that nobody is
standing. Polling and coverage figures are not forecasts or recommendations.
The Victorian Electoral Commission is authoritative. Formal nominations for
the 2026 election close at 12 noon on 9 November 2026.

## Machine-readable data

The stable export namespace remains /data/vic2026/ and was not moved:

- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/election.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/candidates.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/candidates.csv
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/districts.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/council-members.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/parties.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/retirements.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/coverage.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/representation.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/polls.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/poll-average.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/index.json

Prefer these exports over HTML scraping. The `caveat` field in coverage.json is a
material qualification of every party-coverage figure.
